'''Skig Banos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Sel Zonn Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Banos worked for the Empire as an informant and in about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the [[Alderaanian Security]] agent [[Maya]] was apprehended by the Empire on Sel Zonn Station. Shortly afterward, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that were investigating Maya's arrest confronted Banos on the station's [[Blue Deck]] and interrogated him.
